// CHAOS-5156: closes a gap codex round r1 on #2292 found (independently
// confirmed against real lizard 1.23.0 before fixing). stateFunction was
// missing clikeStates.stateFunction's own "::" branch (clike.go),
// falling through to the not-a-function-after-all default instead of
// stateNameWithSpace. Java has no qualified out-of-line definitions, but
// lizard's tolerant tokenizer still parses this token shape. Measured
// directly against real lizard 1.23.0: complexity 2 (base 1 + if).
class C {
    Foo::bar() {
        if (x > 0) {
            x = x;
        }
    }
}
